# lmw watch

Keep an eye on LinkedIn for you: new posts of someone, jobs, messages...

### Synopsis

Watches tell you when something happens on LinkedIn: the next post of
someone, new jobs for a search, new messages or connection requests. Add
them here (or let an AI assistant add them through MCP), and run
`lmw daemon` on a computer that stays on to check them and notify
you through the channels of `lmw notify`.

Kinds of watches:
  posts          new posts by a member (TARGET: a profile (linkedin.com/in/NAME))
  company        new posts by a company or school page (TARGET: a page (linkedin.com/company/NAME))
  profile        changes to a member's headline or current job (TARGET: a profile (linkedin.com/in/NAME))
  comments       new comments on a post (TARGET: a post (its link or URN))
  jobs           new job postings for a search (TARGET: the search keywords)
  views          new people viewing your profile
  invitations    new connection requests
  messages       new messages in your inbox
  notifications  new notifications
  unread         more unread notifications, messages or invitations (the top bar badges)

All watches together may use a third of the hourly request budget, and half
the daily budget over a day: about 6 requests an hour by default. A posts
watch every 30 minutes uses 2.
